baseline.name: Armour Pierce
baseline.effectsText: Your Melee attacks gain +1 Armour Penetration, ignoring 1 AV when calculating damage. This bonus does not add extra damage if the target has no AV. Scales to +2 at level 5 and +3 at level 9.

baseline.name: Sweeping Strike
baseline.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack. Roll 1d4 to determine how many Adjacent enemies are hit. Success: Deal 1d10+HL damage. Failure: Deal half damage.

tier1.name: Brutal Rush
tier1.effectsText: Charge a Nearby enemy and make a Basic Attack. AR and damage are boosted by your Armour Pierce bonus. Success: Fury cost is refunded. Failure: Normal miss result.

upgrades.name: Ironside
upgrades.description: Gain +MIGHT to AV against Provoked Attacks while charging.

upgrades.name: Battle Shout
upgrades.description: Gain 1 additional Fury on success.

tier1.name: Iron Stance
tier1.effectsText: Declare before an incoming attack's damage roll. Gain +MIGHT as universal Damage Resistance against that single attack.

tier1.name: Outnumbered
tier1.effectsText: While more than 1 enemy is Adjacent, add +1 damage per extra enemy beyond the first (increases to +2 per enemy at Level 6). This bonus cannot exceed HL.

tier1.name: Wide Sweep
tier1.effectsText: Your Sweeping Strike now hits up to 1d4+1 targets instead of 1d4. If one or more targets die, refund 1 Fury.

tier1.name: Wild Swing
tier1.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack. Success: Deal Basic Attack damage plus an additional 1d4+MIGHT+HL damage. Failure: Miss and suffer a retaliation attack with 0 AV; refund 1 Fury.

upgrades.name: Focused Rage
upgrades.description: Can be combined with another power as a Quick action; non-single targets take half damage from the combo.

upgrades.name: Reckless Guard
upgrades.description: Do not lose AV on the retaliation from a failed attack.

tier1.name: Skewer
tier1.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack. Success: Deal Basic Attack damage; target suffers Hindrance on movement for 1 round. Failure: Deal half Basic Attack damage.

upgrades.name: Anchor
upgrades.description: Spend 1 additional Fury to also lower the target's AR by +MIGHT for 1 round.

tier1.name: Blood Rush
tier1.effectsText: For 3 rounds, heal for half the damage you inflict after mitigation.

tier1.name: Bloodied Resolve
tier1.effectsText: While below half your maximum HP, your AV counts as universal Damage Resistance. This does not apply to the blow that drops you below half HP.

upgrades.name: Unstoppable
upgrades.description: While Bloodied Resolve is active, AV is further increased by your Armour Pierce bonus.

tier1.name: Toss Ally
tier1.effectsText: Grab an Adjacent Ally and launch them to a Nearby enemy or location. If targeting an enemy, roll your Basic Attack. Success: The target takes no damage but is Staggered for 1 round. The launched Ally does not spend a Movement action.

upgrades.name: Living Projectile
upgrades.description: The launched Ally also deals Basic Attack damage in addition to Staggering the target.

tier1.name: Frenzy
tier1.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack. Success: Deal Basic Attack damage plus an additional +1d4 damage that stacks each consecutive use. Failure: Deal half damage and lose 1 damage stack if applicable.

upgrades.name: Rhythm
upgrades.description: Cost reduced to 1 Fury.

upgrades.name: Second Chance
upgrades.description: Spend 1 Fury to reroll a failed attack roll once per round.

upgrades.name: Escalate
upgrades.description: The stacking damage die increases to 1d8.

tier2.name: Shattering Strike
tier2.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack. Success: Deal Basic Attack damage ignoring all AV; your Armour Pierce bonus converts to additional damage instead. Failure: Deal half Basic Attack damage ignoring AV, but no Armour Pierce bonus.

upgrades.name: Overwhelm
upgrades.description: Double your Armour Pierce bonus on success.

upgrades.name: Dent Armour
upgrades.description: Reduce the target's AV by HL for 1 round.

tier2.name: Meat Shield
tier2.effectsText: When you would be hit, grab an Adjacent enemy to intercept the attack (must be Medium or smaller, not the attacker, not immune to displacement, not an MR attack). Success: The grabbed enemy suffers the attack's damage. Failure: You suffer full damage. If the target is Elite, Contest MIGHT vs. MIGHT.

upgrades.name: Opportunist
upgrades.description: Generate 5 Fury if the Meat Shield target dies.

upgrades.name: Iron Grip
upgrades.description: Spend 1 additional Fury to gain Benefit on the grab attempt.

tier2.name: Battle Roar
tier2.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack targeting MR against all Adjacent enemies. Success: They cannot perform Provoked Attacks for 1 round. Failure: They suffer Hindrance on Provoked Attacks.

upgrades.name: Overwhelmed
upgrades.description: Affected targets are also Staggered; the power no longer requires a Movement action.

upgrades.name: Rally
upgrades.description: Adjacent Allies gain HL to AR and damage on their next attack.

tier2.name: Pain to Power
tier2.effectsText: Whenever you take damage from a single attack before mitigation equal to or greater than twice your Level, instantly gain 1 Fury. Multiple triggers from one attack are possible.

tier2.name: Momentum
tier2.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack against a Nearby target. Success: Deal Basic Attack damage and gain 1 Momentum stack. Failure: Deal half damage; stacks are maintained. Each stack increases your damage and DR by +2. Stacks fall off after 1 round if not refreshed.

upgrades.name: Unstoppable Force
upgrades.description: Momentum stacks also increase AV by +2 each.

upgrades.name: Overwhelming
upgrades.description: Each stack grants +3 instead of +2.

upgrades.name: Stubborn
upgrades.description: Refund 1 Fury on a failed attack.

tier2.name: Whirlwind
tier2.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack. Success: All Adjacent enemies take 2d8+MIGHT damage. Failure: All Adjacent enemies take +MIGHT damage.

upgrades.name: Eye of the Storm
upgrades.description: Your DR and AV increase by +MIGHT until your next turn.

upgrades.name: Unending Fury
upgrades.description: If you hit 4 or more enemies, reset the Overdrive tag.

tier2.name: Deep Cut
tier2.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack. Success: Deal Basic Attack damage and leave a Deep Cut on the target (attacks against the target gain +1 damage, stacking up to your Level; lasts until end of next turn). Failure: Deal half damage; no Deep Cut.

upgrades.name: Open Wound
upgrades.description: Each attack against the wounded target deals +2 damage per stack instead of +1.

upgrades.name: Grievous Injury
upgrades.description: Healing and regeneration on the wounded target are halved.

upgrades.name: Efficient
upgrades.description: Cost reduced to 1 Fury.

tier2.name: Desperate Defiance
tier2.effectsText: When your HP is reduced to 0 or below, immediately make one Basic Attack against an Adjacent enemy and heal for half the damage inflicted. Once per Full Rest.

upgrades.name: Controlled
upgrades.description: Use a power instead of a Basic Attack when Desperate Defiance triggers.

lv3.name: Steadfast Protector
lv3.effectsText: You may pick up and carry an Incapacitated Ally with you, spending your Quick and Movement actions. While doing so, you shield your Ally from Provoked Attacks with your own body. If you have the power Toss Ally, its Fury cost is free for one use whenever an Ally falls on the battlefield.

lv8.name: Undaunted
lv8.effectsText: When a fear or intimidation effect is used against you, activate Undaunted to become immune to it for 1 round.

lv10.name: Earthshatter
lv10.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack. Success: All enemies Adjacent and up to a Nearby distance away take 2d20 damage. If your attack beats the target's DR by 3 or more, the target is Stunned for 1 round. You gain +8 to your DR for 2 rounds. Failure: You deal half damage. Allies receive +6 to AR and Damage on their next attack.

baseline.name: Vital Exchange
baseline.effectsText: Sacrifice life force to restore power. Recharge 1 Bile.

baseline.name: Draining Blow
baseline.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack. Success: Deal Basic Attack damage and restore HL+MIND HP. Failure: Deal half damage and restore HL HP.

tier1.name: Corrosive Ichor
tier1.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack. Success: Deal 1d4+MIND Corrosive damage and spawn up to HL Festering Pustules on the target. Pustules burst for 1d4 Corrosive damage each to the target and Adjacent enemies when the target takes damage. Failure: Deal 1d4 Corrosive damage.

upgrades.name: Potent Toxin
upgrades.description: Pustules deal 1d6 damage each instead of 1d4.

upgrades.name: Spreading Blight
upgrades.description: Spawn 1 Pustule even on failure.

upgrades.name: Parasitic Wounds
upgrades.description: Restore HP equal to half of the total Pustule damage dealt.

tier1.name: Aberrant Physique
tier1.effectsText: Permanently gain +10 maximum HP but lose 1 maximum Bile. Can be taken up to 2 times, once per level.

upgrades.name: Void-Touched Strength
upgrades.description: Your Basic Attack damage die becomes 1d12 or 2d6.

tier1.name: Spectral Fetters
tier1.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack. Success: Drag the target to your location. Contest MIGHT vs. MIND if the target is larger than Medium or Elite. Failure: Mark the target — your next Spectral Fetters against them gains Benefit (lasts until end of your next turn).

upgrades.name: Burning Bonds
upgrades.description: As a Quick action, spend 1d4 Blood to deal double damage + MIND Corrosive to the tethered target.

upgrades.name: Leeching Tether
upgrades.description: Spend 1 Bile to restore HL+MIND HP.

upgrades.name: Shattering Release
upgrades.description: On a successful drag, shatter the bonds to deal 1d4+HL+MIND Corrosive to enemies Adjacent to the target.

tier1.name: Unnatural Swiftness
tier1.effectsText: Permanently increase AGILITY by +1 but reduce maximum HP by 4. Can be taken up to 3 times, once per level.

upgrades.name: Phase Shimmer
upgrades.description: Spend 1 Bile as a Reaction to increase DR by +MIND against an incoming attack. Declare before rolling.

tier1.name: Osseous Cage
tier1.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack to determine X. Encase the target — they cannot move but may still attack. The cage absorbs damage up to LEVEL+MIND+X before collapsing. Only one cage can be active at a time.

upgrades.name: Spreading Snare
upgrades.description: You can maintain multiple cages simultaneously.

upgrades.name: Jagged Protrusions
upgrades.description: Melee attackers who strike the cage take +MIND Physical damage.

tier1.name: Void Carapace
tier1.effectsText: Gain +2 AV permanently but lose 1 PRESENCE.

upgrades.name: Reinforced Shell
upgrades.description: Spend 2 Bile as a Reaction to gain additional AV equal to +MIND against a single incoming attack.

tier1.name: Marked Prey
tier1.effectsText: Draining Blow leaves a mark on its target. Your next Draining Blow against that target gains Benefit. The mark lasts until end of your next turn.

upgrades.name: Hungry Strike
upgrades.description: Spend 1 Bile to restore an additional +MIND HP on a successful Draining Blow hit.

tier1.name: Terror Vision
tier1.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack targeting MR. Success: Deal 1d8+MIND True damage; target cannot attack you for 2 rounds. Failure: Deal half damage; target cannot attack you for 1 round.

upgrades.name: Spreading Terror
upgrades.description: One Ally of your choice also gains immunity from the target's attacks.

upgrades.name: Overwhelming Dread
upgrades.description: Terror Vision is always cast with Benefit and costs no Bile.

upgrades.name: Deep Wounds
upgrades.description: Damage increased to 1d12+MIND+LEVEL.

tier2.name: Vital Leech
tier2.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack. Success: A leech latches onto the target, dealing +MIND damage and restoring that amount as HP. While Maintained, the leech repeats at the start of your next turn. Only 1 leech can be active at a time.

upgrades.name: Spreading Infestation
upgrades.description: You can maintain multiple leeches simultaneously.

upgrades.name: Shared Feast
upgrades.description: Allies striking a leeched target restore 1d4 HP.

tier2.name: Death Harvest
tier2.effectsText: When any enemy dies, restore HL HP.

upgrades.name: Death Surge
upgrades.description: When an enemy dies, your next attack gains HL to AR. This does not stack from multiple deaths.

tier2.name: Cadaver Burst
tier2.effectsText: Target an organic corpse up to Far distance. Roll your Basic Attack to hit all creatures Adjacent to the corpse. Success: Deal 2d4+HL+MIND Corrosive damage. Failure: Deal half damage.

upgrades.name: Toxic Cloud
upgrades.description: A cloud of gas lingers, dealing +MIND Corrosive damage to anyone in the area for 2 rounds.

upgrades.name: Nauseating Vapors
upgrades.description: Targets hit are also Staggered.

tier2.name: Essence Rend
tier2.effectsText: Choose how much Blood to expend (up to your current Level). Roll your Basic Attack. Success: Deal 1d6+X Fire damage. If the target is killed, the Bile cost is refunded. Failure: Deal half damage.

upgrades.name: Shared Harvest
upgrades.description: Share your Death Harvest restoration with Allies on each trigger.

upgrades.name: Reckless Expenditure
upgrades.description: Double the Blood expenditure for doubled bonus damage.

tier2.name: Life Bond
tier2.effectsText: Tether yourself to a willing Ally. All damage is split in half (rounded down) between both of you. All healing restores the full amount to both of you. Lasts until end of battle, 10 minutes, or either of you becomes Incapacitated or moves out of range.

upgrades.name: Life Exchange
upgrades.description: As a Quick action, you and your bonded Ally can transfer life force between each other.

upgrades.name: Shared Recovery
upgrades.description: Both bonded characters regenerate 1 Class Resource per round.

tier2.name: Phase Step
tier2.effectsText: Blink up to Far distance, bypassing all Provoked Attacks.

tier2.name: Silencing Grip
tier2.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack. Success: Prevent the target from casting or using powers for 1 round (interrupts if mid-cast); deal +MIND damage. Contest MIGHT vs. MIND if larger than Medium or Elite. Failure: Deal half damage.

upgrades.name: Tightening Hold
upgrades.description: Spend 1d4+HL Blood to deal double damage.

upgrades.name: Extended Reach
upgrades.description: Range increased to Far.

tier2.name: Mental Erosion
tier2.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack to determine X. Reduce the target's MR based on X: 2–8 = −2, 9–15 = −3, 16–21 = −4, 22+ = −5. Effect lasts 1 round.

upgrades.name: Mental Rebound
upgrades.description: The afflicted target suffers the MR penalty as True damage whenever they attack or move.

upgrades.name: Prolonged Confusion
upgrades.description: Duration increased to 2 rounds.

upgrades.name: Resistance Fracture
upgrades.description: Also reduce one elemental resistance by the same amount as the MR penalty.

lv3.name: Void Whispers
lv3.effectsText: Briefly intrude upon the mind of a thinking creature, lowering the TN by HL for any coercion or haggling an Ally applies to that target while you channel this power.

lv8.name: Mental Bridge
lv8.effectsText: Open a telepathic channel with an intelligent creature that understands the language you are using. Lasts 1 minute.

lv10.name: Mind Domination
lv10.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack; targets Mental Resistance (MR). Maintaining this power costs 1d4 Blood per round. Success: You seize control of the target each round, beginning at the start of your turn. The GM may reveal the target's stats and abilities. You use the dominated target's Attack and Defense rolls to determine hits. Rolling doubles while dominating a target recharges 1 Bile per standard Driftwalker rules. If the target is Elite, you must Contest MIND vs. MIND initially and each round to continue. Failure: Your target is badly shaken by the assault and suffers Hindrance on all actions for 2 rounds.

baseline.name: Close Quarters Fire
baseline.effectsText: You suffer no Hindrance penalty when attacking with a ranged weapon while Adjacent to an enemy.

baseline.name: Evasive Bound
baseline.effectsText: Use your Movement action to leap up to a Nearby distance into or away from danger. While leaping you gain Benefit against all Provoked Attacks.

tier1.name: Opening Salvo
tier1.effectsText: Your first attack of battle gains +AGILITY to AR and damage.

upgrades.name: Watchful Patience
upgrades.description: Opening Salvo reactivates if you haven't used a Standard action yet this battle.

upgrades.name: Aimed Shot
upgrades.description: Gain Benefit on the Opening Salvo attack roll.

tier1.name: Suppression Volley
tier1.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack against a group of Adjacent enemies. Success: Deal Basic Attack damage and targets cannot perform Provoked Attacks. Failure: Targets still cannot perform Provoked Attacks.

upgrades.name: Sustained Barrage
upgrades.description: Cast with Benefit; cost reduced to 1 Focus.

upgrades.name: Pinning Volley
upgrades.description: Targets are also Rooted for 1 round.

tier1.name: Hardened Conditioning
tier1.effectsText: Select 1 energy type; gain +AGILITY Resistance to that type. Can be taken multiple times for different energy types.

tier1.name: Concealment Cloud
tier1.effectsText: You and all Adjacent creatures gain Benefit on Defense rolls against Ranged attacks for 1 round. Moving away from your location removes the bonus.

tier1.name: Nimble Escape
tier1.effectsText: Combine with Evasive Bound using this Quick action and 1 additional Focus. When leaping away from Adjacent enemies, you are immune to Provoked Attacks.

tier1.name: Timed Charge
tier1.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack. Success: Attach a timed charge; set a detonation timer of 1–3 rounds. When it detonates, deal 1d4+AGILITY Fire damage to the target and all creatures Adjacent to it. Failure: Deal 1d6 damage as the device bounces off.

upgrades.name: Early Trigger
upgrades.description: Detonate the charge early as a Quick action.

upgrades.name: High Yield
upgrades.description: The explosion damage die increases to 1d10.

tier1.name: Split Strike
tier1.effectsText: Target 2 Adjacent creatures (a primary and secondary). Roll your Basic Attack against the primary. Success: Deal full damage to the primary and half damage to the secondary. Failure: Deal half damage to the primary only.

upgrades.name: Swift Follow-Through
upgrades.description: Refund 1 Focus on success.

tier1.name: Electric Snare
tier1.effectsText: With no enemies Adjacent, roll your Basic Attack to determine X. The first enemy who moves Adjacent to you triggers the snare, suffering X+AGILITY Electric damage and a status effect based on the roll: 2–8 Staggered, 9–15 Rooted, 16+ Stunned (1 round). The snare is disabled if you move away.

tier1.name: Focused Barrage
tier1.effectsText: Fire multiple ranged Basic Attacks in one action. Each successive shot after the first suffers −2 to AR and damage (cumulative). Limited only by your resource pool.

upgrades.name: Flow State
upgrades.description: Refund 1 Focus for each successful shot after the first.

upgrades.name: Practiced Rhythm
upgrades.description: The stacking penalty is reduced to −1 per shot.

tier2.name: Sharpshooter
tier2.effectsText: Extend your Basic Ranged Attack range to Very Far. Targets at Far or Very Far distance take an additional +1d6 Physical damage on a successful hit.

upgrades.name: Fell Slayer
upgrades.description: The bonus damage applies at ALL ranges when attacking Demons.

tier2.name: Feint
tier2.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack targeting MR. Success: The next attack against the target gains a HL bonus to AR; enables powers requiring a distracted target. Lasts 1 round. Failure: The next attack gains +1 AR. Lasts 1 round.

upgrades.name: Quick Feint
upgrades.description: Feint uses a Quick action instead of Standard.

tier2.name: Rally Focus
tier2.effectsText: When you have 1 or fewer Focus remaining in battle, use this action to generate 2 Focus.

tier2.name: Evasive Maneuver
tier2.effectsText: Your DR increases by HL against the next single incoming attack. If not triggered before the start of your next turn, the effect expires.

upgrades.name: Team Cover
upgrades.description: Spend 1 additional Focus to extend the DR bonus to Adjacent Allies.

upgrades.name: Deep Cover
upgrades.description: DR bonus is doubled against ranged attacks; +2 to stealth checks.

tier2.name: Shock Anchor
tier2.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack. Success: Deal Basic Attack damage as Electric and embed a shock anchor (only 1 at a time). While maintained, enemies starting their turn Adjacent to the anchor take +AGILITY Electric damage, and Electric attacks against the anchor's target splash half damage to Adjacent enemies. Failure: Deal half damage; anchor doesn't embed.

upgrades.name: High Voltage
upgrades.description: Area damage increased to 1d8+AGILITY.

upgrades.name: Persistent Arc
upgrades.description: No maintain cost; anchor lasts until end of combat.

tier2.name: Vital Strike
tier2.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack. Success: Deal 2d8+AGILITY+HL damage; target is Exposed (attacks trigger Massive Hit or Adrenaline Rush on rolls of 17–20 instead of 20 only, for 1 round). Failure: Deal half damage; target Staggered for 1 round.

upgrades.name: Exposed Weakness
upgrades.description: Exposed triggers on rolls of 16–20.

upgrades.name: Extended Exposure
upgrades.description: The Exposed effect lasts an additional round.

tier2.name: Concussive Shot
tier2.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack. Success: Deal Basic Attack damage; target Staggered for 1 round. Failure: Deal half Basic Attack damage.

upgrades.name: Knockback Force
upgrades.description: Spend 1 additional Focus to push the target Nearby away. Contest MIGHT vs. AGILITY if Elite or larger.

upgrades.name: Heavy Rounds
upgrades.description: Target is Staggered even on failure; gain Benefit on the Contest if you have Knockback Force.

tier2.name: Called Shot
tier2.effectsText: Trade up to HL in AR for an equal damage bonus (e.g., −5 AR for +5 damage).

upgrades.name: Practiced Aim
upgrades.description: The damage bonus is doubled.

lv3.name: Wilderness Expert
lv3.effectsText: When travelling by land, any journey of 3 days or longer can be reduced by 1 day. When taking a Full Rest in the wilderness or other unsafe areas, the chance of an Intrusion is reduced by 1 — the GM picks only 1 Intrusion number instead of 2.

lv8.name: Predator's Instinct
lv8.effectsText: Gain Benefit on any roll involving detection of creatures that are sneaking or hiding nearby. You no longer suffer Hindrance when attacking targets obscured by illusions, stealth, or invisibility.

lv10.name: Relentless Aim
lv10.effectsText: Each time you miss an attack in combat, gain +1 AR until you successfully strike a target. Stacks indefinitely until you hit or combat ends, then resets to 0.

baseline.name: Unyielding Faith
baseline.effectsText: When not wielding a shield: Re-roll any weapon damage dice that show a 1 or 2; you must accept the second roll. When wielding a shield: Re-roll a Defense roll if the 2d10 portion shows 2–5; you must accept the second roll.

baseline.name: Sacred Smite
baseline.effectsText: Upon dealing Melee damage, add a Divine damage bonus: +1d4 at levels 1–4, +1d6 at levels 5–9, +1d8 at level 10.

tier1.name: Warding Strike
tier1.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack. Success: Deal Basic Attack damage; lower the target's AR by HL for 1 round. Failure: Deal half Basic Attack damage.

upgrades.name: Ripple Effect
upgrades.description: An enemy Adjacent to the target also has their AR lowered.

upgrades.name: Efficient Devotion
upgrades.description: Refund 1 Fervor on success.

tier1.name: Steadfast Guard
tier1.effectsText: Activate after a failed Defense roll, before damage is rolled. Increase your AV by 1d4+PRESENCE (increases to 2d4 at Level 5) against that single attack.

tier1.name: Sacred Bane
tier1.effectsText: Deal an additional HL Physical damage to Undead or Demonic enemies.

tier1.name: Vanguard Strike
tier1.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack. Success: Deal Basic Attack damage; inspire a Nearby Ally, granting them 2 Class Resource points. Failure: Deal half damage; the Ally still recharges 1 Class Resource.

upgrades.name: Invigorating Blow
upgrades.description: Gain 1 Fervor on success.

upgrades.name: Blessed Timing
upgrades.description: Rolling 16–20 on the base 2d10 makes this power cost 0 Fervor.

tier1.name: Sacred Ward
tier1.effectsText: Declare before making a Defense roll. Add +PRESENCE to that roll.

tier1.name: Sworn Quarry
tier1.effectsText: Designate a single enemy. All single-target offensive abilities (including Overdrives) against that enemy cost 2 Fervor less for 10 minutes or until you attack a different enemy, the chosen enemy dies, or they become Incapacitated or Stunned.

upgrades.name: Relentless Focus
upgrades.description: Gain Benefit on all rolls involving the selected target.

tier1.name: Distant Reckoning
tier1.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack. Success: Deal Basic Attack damage. Failure: Deal half Basic Attack damage.

upgrades.name: Swift Judgment
upgrades.description: Refund the Fervor cost on success.

upgrades.name: Branded for Reckoning
upgrades.description: Mark the target; the next successful attack against them adds +MIGHT Divine damage. Expires on activation or at end of your next turn.

tier1.name: Divine Rush
tier1.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack to determine X. Dash to a Nearby area, avoiding Provoked Attacks. Deal automatic Divine damage to all Adjacent enemies based on X: 2–8 = 1d6, 9–15 = 2d4, 16–21 = 2d6, 22+ = 2d8.

upgrades.name: Unimpeded Rush
upgrades.description: Range increased to Far; the power costs no Fervor.

upgrades.name: Blazing Impact
upgrades.description: Damage increased by +MIGHT and +PRESENCE.

tier1.name: Battle Commander
tier1.effectsText: Each Ally Adjacent to you grants +1 to your DR (maximum bonus of HL).

upgrades.name: Rally to Me!
upgrades.description: Spend 3 Fervor as a Quick action to grant Adjacent Allies the Battle Commander DR bonus for 1 round.

tier2.name: Leadership Aura
tier2.effectsText: Each time you take a Standard action, grant a Nearby Ally of your choice +2 to AR on their next single attack. This bonus expires after 1 round.

upgrades.name: Adaptive Command
upgrades.description: Grant a +DR bonus instead of +AR.

tier2.name: Relentless Assault
tier2.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack. Success: Deal Basic Attack damage; spend 1 Fervor to attempt another strike (+MIGHT damage). Continue chaining while hits land and resources allow. Failure: Deal half damage; Relentless Assault ends.

upgrades.name: Measured Strike
upgrades.description: The initial attack gains Benefit.

upgrades.name: Divine Edge
upgrades.description: Subsequent chain strikes deal Divine damage.

tier2.name: Guardian's Reprisal
tier2.effectsText: When an Adjacent Ally is struck by a melee attack, immediately retaliate against the attacker with a Basic Attack.

upgrades.name: True Strike
upgrades.description: Your retaliation always hits.

upgrades.name: Savage Reprisal
upgrades.description: Inflict an additional +1d8 damage on the retaliation.

upgrades.name: Efficient Reprisal
upgrades.description: Refund 1 Fervor on success (guaranteed if you have True Strike).

tier2.name: Avenger's Resolve
tier2.effectsText: Gain +1 to AR, AV, and damage for each party member who is Incapacitated or dead. Bonuses last until end of battle and decrease when an Ally is revived.

tier2.name: Consecrated Ground
tier2.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack against all Adjacent enemies. Success: Deal 1d6+MIGHT+HL Divine damage. Failure: Deal half damage. Lingering effect for 2 rounds: enemies suffer HL AR/DR penalty; Allies gain HL AR/DR bonus.

upgrades.name: Restorative Ground
upgrades.description: All creatures on the consecrated ground also restore LEVEL+PRESENCE HP at the start of each round.

upgrades.name: Mobile Sanctum
upgrades.description: Consecrated Ground follows you as you move.

tier2.name: Divine Thunder
tier2.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack. Success: Deal 2d8+MIGHT+HL Electric damage; target Stunned for 1 round. Failure: Deal half damage; target Staggered.

upgrades.name: Shockwave
upgrades.description: Adjacent targets also suffer half damage as Electric.

upgrades.name: Charged Battlefield
upgrades.description: Nearby Allies' Physical attacks become Electric for 1 round.

tier2.name: Condemning Gaze
tier2.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack targeting MR. Success: Deal 1d6+MIGHT Divine damage; target Rooted for 1 round. Failure: Deal half damage; target Staggered.

upgrades.name: Efficient Condemnation
upgrades.description: Cost reduced to 2 Fervor.

upgrades.name: Far-Reaching Judgment
upgrades.description: Range increased to Far; deals +PRESENCE additional damage.

tier2.name: Punishing Aura
tier2.effectsText: While Maintained, any enemy that lands a melee strike on you suffers +MIGHT Divine damage.

upgrades.name: Shared Punishment
upgrades.description: All Adjacent Allies gain the Punishing Aura effect for 1 round.

upgrades.name: Sustained Vigilance
upgrades.description: Activation and maintain costs are each reduced to 1 Fervor.

tier2.name: Sacred Flames
tier2.effectsText: While Maintained, all your Physical attacks deal Fire damage instead. Powers with a different elemental type override this while active.

upgrades.name: Shared Blaze
upgrades.description: Spend 1 additional Fervor to grant an Adjacent Ally the same effect. New maintain cost becomes 4 Fervor.

lv3.name: Commanding Presence
lv3.effectsText: Your Presence is permanently increased by +1.

lv8.name: Absolution
lv8.effectsText: Remove 1 Status Effect from an Adjacent target from the following list: Hindered, Poisoned, Diseased, Staggered, Rooted, Confused, Stunned. The target is also restored for Level × 5 HP. You can use Absolution on yourself.

lv10.name: Divine Descent
lv10.effectsText: You vanish from the battlefield as soon as you activate this power. At the start of your next turn you may land anywhere on the battlefield and roll your dice. Success: Deal 1d20+2d6 Divine damage to all enemies Adjacent and up to a Nearby distance; all Allies on the battlefield are inspired, receiving +6 to AR and Damage on their next attack. Failure: Deal half damage; Allies still receive +6 to AR and Damage on their next attack.

baseline.name: Arcane Bolt
baseline.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack. Success: Deal 1d8+MIND damage. Failure: Miss.

baseline.name: Spell Surge
baseline.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack to determine X. Your next damaging spell deals an extra X damage in the elemental form of that spell. Spell Surge does not stack; declare which spell you are Surging when you activate it. When you use Spell Surge, roll 1d10 — 1-5: Mend (heal +MIND); 6-10: Arcane Shell (gain +MIND to AV for 1 round). Basic Attack result: 2-8 = 1d6, 9-19 = 2d4, 20-24 = 2d6, 25+ = 2d8.

tier1.name: Volt Strike
tier1.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack. Success: Deal 1d12+HL+MIND Electric damage; afflict the target with Static Residue (any Electric attack against them auto-hits; expires on trigger). Failure: Deal half damage; Static Residue still applied.

upgrades.name: Extended Range
upgrades.description: Range increased to Very Far.

tier1.name: Vortex
tier1.effectsText: Choose a Far location. Roll your Basic Attack against Nearby enemies. Success: Pull them onto that point, placing them all Adjacent to each other. Failure: Targets are Staggered instead.

upgrades.name: Crushing Center
upgrades.description: Pulled enemies are also Rooted.

upgrades.name: Burst Collapse
upgrades.description: Spend 1 Mana to deal 1d12+MIND+HL damage to all pulled enemies.

tier1.name: Ice Shard
tier1.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack. Success: Deal 1d8+HL+MIND Frost damage; reduce the target's AV by +MIND against the next Physical attack for 1 round (can go negative). Failure: Deal half damage.

upgrades.name: Efficient Cast
upgrades.description: Refund 1 Mana on success.

upgrades.name: Persistent Chill
upgrades.description: The AV penalty applies even on failure.

tier1.name: Survival Blink
tier1.effectsText: Once per Full Rest, when damage would reduce you to 0 HP in combat, negate that damage and teleport to a Nearby location instead.

upgrades.name: Retaliatory Pulse
upgrades.description: Deal 1d12+MIND Arcane damage to the source of the negated attack.

tier1.name: Arcane Leap
tier1.effectsText: Jump up to 10 meters vertically within Nearby distance. Avoid Provoked Attacks unless the enemy can fly or levitate.

upgrades.name: Double Jump
upgrades.description: Jump again immediately after landing; costs 1 additional Mana.

tier1.name: Corrosive Bolt
tier1.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack. Success: Deal 1d6+MIND Corrosive damage; the target suffers +MIND Corrosive damage at the start of their turn for 2 rounds (refreshed by new hits). Failure: Deal half damage.

upgrades.name: Conservation
upgrades.description: Refund 1 Mana on failure.

tier1.name: Mana Flow
tier1.effectsText: Add +2 to all Mana Recharge rolls.

upgrades.name: Last Reserves
upgrades.description: When at 2 or less Mana, your Arcane Bolt class feature gains Benefit.

tier1.name: Arcane Barrier
tier1.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack to determine X. Conjure a barrier that absorbs X+MIND damage (all types except True). When the barrier is destroyed, it explodes for half its absorption value as Arcane damage to Adjacent enemies. Lasts while Maintained or until shattered.

upgrades.name: Directed Blast
upgrades.description: The explosion only damages enemies.

upgrades.name: Reinforced Field
upgrades.description: Absorption value also includes LEVEL.

tier1.name: Flame Wave
tier1.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack against 1d4+1 Adjacent enemies. Success: Deal 1d8+HL+MIND Fire damage. Failure: Deal half damage.

upgrades.name: Searing Flash
upgrades.description: Targets suffer Hindrance on Provoked Attacks for 1 round.

upgrades.name: Full Sweep
upgrades.description: Hit all Adjacent enemies instead of 1d4+1.

tier2.name: Mana Blade
tier2.effectsText: Conjure a magical melee weapon (1d8+MIND Arcane damage). Basic Melee Attack rules apply. Each enemy you strike recharges 2 Mana. Lasts while Maintained.

upgrades.name: Charged Weapon
upgrades.description: Mark an enemy; Allies striking that enemy recharge 1 Class Resource. Only 1 mark per enemy.

upgrades.name: Heavy Weave
upgrades.description: Damage increased to 2d6+MIND.

tier2.name: Illusory Form
tier2.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack to determine X: 2–11 = 2, 12–19 = 3, 20–23 = 4, 24+ = 5. Increase your DR by HL×X. Lasts until end of battle or 10 minutes, or until you take damage.

upgrades.name: Resilient Illusion
upgrades.description: On taking damage, roll 1d10; on 6+ the illusion persists, on 5 or below it cancels.

upgrades.name: Deep Blur
upgrades.description: Gain Benefit on the determining roll; also gain HL bonus to stealth.

tier2.name: Blazing Orb
tier2.effectsText: Choose a primary target. Roll your Basic Attack. Success: Deal 2d8+MIND Fire damage to the primary target and 1d8+MIND to all Adjacent targets. Failure: Deal half damage to the primary and 1d6 damage to Adjacent targets.

upgrades.name: Burning Ground
upgrades.description: The area burns for 2 rounds; anyone starting their turn there suffers +MIND Fire damage.

tier2.name: Acid Lash
tier2.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack. Success: Deal 2d6+HL+MIND Corrosive damage; target's DR is reduced by HL for 1 round. Failure: Deal half damage.

upgrades.name: Splatter
upgrades.description: On success, automatically deal +MIND Corrosive damage to all enemies Adjacent to the target.

tier2.name: Flash Freeze
tier2.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack. Success: Deal 1d10+HL+MIND Frost damage; target Rooted for 1 round. Failure: Deal +MIND Frost damage.

upgrades.name: Ice Shatter
upgrades.description: The next attack on a Rooted target explodes ice, dealing 1d4+MIND to Adjacent enemies.

upgrades.name: Frozen Solid
upgrades.description: Spend 2 additional Mana to Stun the target for 1 round instead. Contest if Elite.

upgrades.name: Favorable Winds
upgrades.description: Gain Benefit on Flash Freeze; this also applies to any Contest.

tier2.name: Hover
tier2.effectsText: Float 2 meters off the ground for the battle or 10 minutes. Gain Benefit against Provoked Attacks. Cancelled when you take damage.

upgrades.name: Elevated Position
upgrades.description: +2 to DR while hovering.

upgrades.name: Focused Concentration
upgrades.description: Spend 1 Mana when taking damage to prevent hovering from being cancelled.

tier2.name: Warp
tier2.effectsText: Set a Warp Point as a Quick action (2 Mana; lasts battle or 10 minutes). Warp back to your Warp Point as a Quick action (1 Mana; can be used multiple times). Immune to Provoked Attacks during warp.

upgrades.name: Ally Swap
upgrades.description: Without a Warp Point, swap positions with a willing Ally up to Far away (1 Mana; uses the Overdrive tag).

tier2.name: Kinetic Burst
tier2.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack. Success: Deal 1d12+MIND damage and displace all Adjacent targets Nearby away. Failure: Deal +MIND damage. Does not work on creatures larger than Medium.

upgrades.name: Unstoppable Wave
upgrades.description: Targets are displaced even on failure.

tier2.name: Focused Ray
tier2.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack. Success: Deal 1d8+MIND Arcane damage; gain 1 Focused Mind stack. Failure: Deal no damage; gain 1 stack. Each stack increases damage by 1d8 and reduces cost by 1. Moving or taking damage loses all stacks.

upgrades.name: Mobile Focus
upgrades.description: Moving does not cause you to lose Focused Mind stacks.

upgrades.name: Amplified Output
upgrades.description: Baseline damage increased to 1d12.

tier2.name: Chained Lightning
tier2.effectsText: Choose a primary target. Roll your Basic Attack. Success: Deal 1d6+MIND damage (bounce 1) and chain to a Nearby or Adjacent target for 1d8+MIND (bounce 2). Continue up to 4 more bounces with increasing damage (1d10, 1d12, 1d20) while hits land. Failure: Deal half damage; chaining ends.

upgrades.name: Sustained Current
upgrades.description: Spend 2 Mana to reroll a failed bounce attempt; can chain this.

upgrades.name: Overcharged
upgrades.description: Start at 1d10 and reach 1d20 in only 2 bounces.

lv3.name: Focus Orb
lv3.effectsText: After a Full Rest, spend and reserve 1 Mana to align yourself to a single elemental type you know (e.g. Frost). Alignment grants HL as bonus elemental damage when using a single-target power of the attuned element. As a Reaction to being attacked or seeing an Ally attacked, you may spend 1 Mana and release the Orb to teleport yourself or the targeted Ally up to Far distance away, or grant yourself HL+MIND to a single attack. The Orb is consumed until your next Full Rest. A small glowing orb matching the element's colour orbits you while active, illuminating up to 5 metres. This light can be toggled on and off at will.

lv8.name: Rift Gate
lv8.effectsText: Open a rift that exits somewhere in your field of view up to a Very Far distance (24m). The rift remains open until the end of combat or 10 minutes outside of combat. Anyone can pass through the rift by walking into it, including enemies.

lv10.name: Time Surge
lv10.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack to determine X. Speed up time for yourself and X allies; chosen targets have their Standard, Movement, Reaction, and Quick Actions available again. 2-14: X=1 | 15-23: X=2 | 24-27: X=3 | 28+: X=4.

baseline.name: Flanking Strike
baseline.effectsText: Whenever you attack an enemy who is Adjacent to an Ally, add 1d4 damage on a successful attack. Attacking from stealth or surprise grants this bonus as well. Bonus increases to: +2d4 at level 5, +3d4 at level 10.

baseline.name: Evasive Roll
baseline.effectsText: Activate immediately after taking Physical damage. Expend 1 Guile to reduce the incoming Physical damage by +AGILITY. You can expend multiple Guile for further damage reduction.

tier1.name: Crippling Strike
tier1.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack. Success: Deal Basic Attack damage + additional +AGILITY True damage. Failure: Deal half Basic Attack damage.

upgrades.name: Agonizing Injury
upgrades.description: Target's Provoked Attacks are disabled for 1 round.

upgrades.name: Quick Recovery
upgrades.description: Refund 1 Guile.

tier1.name: Find the Gap
tier1.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack. Success: Deal Basic Attack damage and leave the target vulnerable for 1 round — the next single attack from any source against them gains the Flanking Strike damage bonus. Failure: Deal half Basic Attack damage.

tier1.name: Nimble
tier1.effectsText: Gain HL as a DR bonus against Provoked Attacks.

tier1.name: Whirling Blades
tier1.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack. Roll 1d4+1 to determine how many Adjacent enemies are hit. Increase your DR by that same number until end of your next turn. Cannot benefit from Flanking Strike with this power.

upgrades.name: Building Momentum
upgrades.description: The DR bonus is increased by +2 per enemy hit.

upgrades.name: Fluid Motion
upgrades.description: Refresh the DR bonus duration by spending 1 Guile as a Quick action.

tier1.name: Ambusher
tier1.effectsText: Your first successful attack in combat inflicts an extra 1d6+HL damage. Once per battle.

upgrades.name: Ruthless
upgrades.description: Gain 2 Guile when Ambusher triggers.

upgrades.name: Persistent Ambush
upgrades.description: Ambusher reactivates if you haven't used a Standard action yet this battle.

tier1.name: Shadow Step
tier1.effectsText: Step through shadows to reappear Adjacent to any animate target (Ally or enemy) within Nearby distance, avoiding all Provoked Attacks.

upgrades.name: Shadow Assault
upgrades.description: Stepping to an enemy surprises them — you can apply Flanking Strike damage without needing an Adjacent Ally.

tier1.name: Blade Flurry
tier1.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack twice. Success on either roll: Deal Basic Attack damage (successful rolls can trigger Flanking Strike). Failure: Deal half damage for failed rolls.

upgrades.name: Efficient Blades
upgrades.description: Refund 1 Guile per miss.

upgrades.name: Triple Strike
upgrades.description: Make 3 Basic Attacks instead of 2.

tier1.name: Escalating Strikes
tier1.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack. Success: Deal 1d4 damage; gain 1 Escalating Strikes stack. Failure: Deal no damage; still gain 1 stack. Each stack adds +1d4 damage and persists indefinitely while refreshed. Stacks are lost if you take any non-Escalating Strikes action or go 1 round idle. Flanking Strike always applies regardless.

upgrades.name: Deeper Wounds
upgrades.description: Each stack adds +1d8 instead; base damage becomes 1d8.

tier2.name: Tendon Cut
tier2.effectsText: Target must be distracted (an Ally is Adjacent to them) or surprised. Roll your Basic Attack. Success: Deal Basic Attack damage; target Rooted for 1 round. Failure: Deal half damage.

upgrades.name: Opportunistic
upgrades.description: No longer requires a distracted or surprised target.

tier2.name: Reflexive Dodge
tier2.effectsText: After using Evasive Roll, roll 1d10. On a 9 or 10, Evasive Roll costs no Guile.

upgrades.name: Honed Instincts
upgrades.description: A roll of 8 also makes Evasive Roll free.

upgrades.name: Last Chance
upgrades.description: When your HP would drop to 0, reduce it to 1 instead. Once per Full Rest. Bypassed by damage exceeding 50% of your maximum HP.

tier2.name: Phantom Double
tier2.effectsText: A copy of you appears. The copy can attack a Far target while you attack an Adjacent one, or both attack the same Adjacent target (both can apply Flanking Strike). The copy mimics your offensive actions up to Overdrive. Lasts 1 round. Copy attacks do not trigger Recharge and cannot benefit from the 9–10 Evasive Roll effect.

upgrades.name: Extended Duration
upgrades.description: Copy lasts an additional round and mimics your next attack.

upgrades.name: Vampiric Double
upgrades.description: Restore HP equal to the total damage the copy inflicts.

tier2.name: Knockout Powder
tier2.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack targeting MR. Does not work on Elite targets. Success: Target falls unconscious until the start of your next turn; they cannot act (waking on damage). Failure: Target Staggered for 1 round.

upgrades.name: Heavy Dose
upgrades.description: Gain Benefit on the roll.

upgrades.name: Wider Spread
upgrades.description: Range increased to Nearby.

tier2.name: Turn the Tables
tier2.effectsText: When you completely negate an Adjacent melee attack using Evasive Roll, roll your Basic Attack. Success: Deal their attack's damage back to them. Failure: Deal half their attack damage back.

upgrades.name: Commit
upgrades.description: Spend 1 extra Guile to gain Benefit on the counter-attack roll.

upgrades.name: Lucky Counter
upgrades.description: Gain half the Guile spent on success.

tier2.name: Deep Reserves
tier2.effectsText: Your maximum Guile is increased by 2 and your Guile recharge die is increased to 1d6.

tier2.name: Keen Edge
tier2.effectsText: While Maintained, your Flanking Strike class feature deals an additional 1d4 damage.

tier2.name: Ghost Strike
tier2.effectsText: Dash to a Nearby target, avoiding Provoked Attacks. Roll your Basic Attack. Success: Deal Basic Attack damage; you may immediately use Ghost Strike again as a Free action (2 Guile) on a different Nearby target. Continue while hitting and resources allow. Failure: Normal miss result.

upgrades.name: Momentum
upgrades.description: Subsequent chain strikes cost only 1 Guile.

upgrades.name: Press the Attack
upgrades.description: Spend 1 additional Guile to reroll a failed attack once.

lv3.name: Street Smart
lv3.effectsText: When entering a town or major city, roll 1d6. 1-3: A 20% discount on anything purchased and 20% more payment on anything sold (always round in your favour). 4-6: All lodgings, food, and recreational activities are free. Benefits last for a week before you can re-roll. The GM may also reveal useful information about the town — interesting NPCs, locales, or background knowledge your character possesses as a skilled operative.

lv8.name: Featherfall
lv8.effectsText: Whenever you are about to take impact damage from falling, you automatically gain a free Evasive Roll effect (that works against falling damage) as strong as spending X Guile, where X is half your current Level.

lv10.name: Deadly Precision
lv10.effectsText: Your Flanking Strike damage is now considered True damage and pierces through all armour, resistances, and shields. It will always deal unmitigated damage in the face of any form of protection. This effect only applies when you are the one dealing the Flanking Strike damage.

baseline.name: Divine Shot
baseline.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack. Success: Deal 1d6+HL+MIND Divine damage and gain 1 Mending Charge. Failure: Deal half damage and gain 1 Mending Charge.

baseline.name: Blessed Strike
baseline.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack. Success: Deal your Basic Attack damage and gain 1 Mending Charge. Failure: Deal half Basic Attack damage and gain 1 Mending Charge.

baseline.name: Mending Charge
baseline.effectsText: Each Mending Charge restores 1+HL+MIND HP. You may expend multiple charges at once on the same target. You start with 1 Mending Charge and every Full Rest grants you 1 Mending Charge.

tier1.name: Admonish
tier1.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack with Benefit (even if Hindered). Success: Refund 1 Faith; choose a Nearby Ally and grant them +2 AR on their next attack (lasts 1 round).

upgrades.name: Effortless Admonition
upgrades.description: Refund 1 additional Faith on success.

tier1.name: Weakening Strike
tier1.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack to determine X: 2–8 = −1, 9–15 = −2, 16–21 = −3, 22+ = −4. Lower the target's DR by X for 1 round.

upgrades.name: Double Weakness
upgrades.description: Also lower the target's MR by the same amount.

upgrades.name: Evasive Follow-up
upgrades.description: Gain Benefit on Defense rolls against the affected target.

upgrades.name: Lasting Weakness
upgrades.description: Duration increased to 2 rounds.

tier1.name: Battle Fervor
tier1.effectsText: Upon dealing melee attack damage, spend 1 Faith to reroll the damage dice and choose the preferred result.

upgrades.name: Doubled Fury
upgrades.description: The rerolled damage deals additional +HL damage.

tier1.name: Devoted Practice
tier1.effectsText: Add +2 to all Faith Recharge rolls.

upgrades.name: Unyielding Resolve
upgrades.description: Roll the Faith Recharge die twice and keep the highest result.

tier1.name: Blazing Brand
tier1.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack. Success: Deal Basic Attack damage as Fire and brand the target (only 1 active brand per Priest). The next hit on the branded target triggers an explosion for HL+MIND Fire damage to the target and all Adjacent enemies. Failure: Deal half +MIND Fire damage.

upgrades.name: Focused Strike
upgrades.description: Spend 1 additional Faith to gain Benefit on the attack roll.

upgrades.name: Steadfast
upgrades.description: Refund 2 Faith on failure.

upgrades.name: Cleansing Flame
upgrades.description: Adjacent Allies restore +MIND HP when the brand explodes.

tier1.name: Holy Surge
tier1.effectsText: Instantly gain 6 bonus Faith (can exceed your maximum). Bonus Faith is spent before your normal pool. Lasts for the battle or 10 minutes outside of combat.

upgrades.name: Shared Surge
upgrades.description: Distribute the 6 bonus Faith among Allies' Class Resources instead.

tier1.name: Protective Ward
tier1.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack to determine X: 2–8 = 1, 9–15 = 2, 16–21 = 3, 22+ = 4. The target (or yourself) gains +X AV for 1 round.

upgrades.name: Painful Ward
upgrades.description: Enemies that hit the warded target take +MIND Divine damage.

upgrades.name: Fortified Ward
upgrades.description: Gain Benefit on the roll; duration increased to 2 rounds.

upgrades.name: Shared Ward
upgrades.description: You always receive the AV bonus in addition to the target.

tier1.name: Noble Sacrifice
tier1.effectsText: Swap your current HP with an Ally within Far distance (the Ally's HP must be lower than yours). Roll your Basic Attack to create an absorption shield on yourself that lasts until end of your next turn.

upgrades.name: Healing Burst
upgrades.description: A burst of light also restores HL+MIND HP to Adjacent Allies.

upgrades.name: Final Explosion
upgrades.description: If you become Incapacitated within 10 minutes, your body explodes for 1d8+HL+MIND Divine damage to Adjacent enemies.

tier1.name: Thunder of Faith
tier1.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack. Success: Deal 1d6+HL+MIND Electric damage. You may convert up to 1 Mending Charge for an additional 1d6+HL Electric damage. Failure: Deal half damage.

upgrades.name: Graceful Fury
upgrades.description: On a successful conversion, roll 1d10; on 6+ the Mending Charge is refunded.

upgrades.name: Resilient Cast
upgrades.description: Refund 1 Faith on failure.

tier2.name: Blinding Flash
tier2.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack. Success: Deal 1d6+HL+MIND Divine damage; blind the target and reduce their AR by +MIND for 1 round. Failure: Deal half damage.

upgrades.name: Light Burst
upgrades.description: An explosion at the target also hits an Adjacent enemy with the same effects.

upgrades.name: Intense Flash
upgrades.description: Damage increased to 2d6+HL+MIND.

tier2.name: Faith's Ward
tier2.effectsText: Instead of restoring a target's HP, you may place an absorption shield of the same value on them (lasts for the battle or 10 minutes outside combat).

upgrades.name: Reflective Ward
upgrades.description: Half of the damage absorbed by the shield is dealt back to the attacker as Divine damage.

tier2.name: Purify
tier2.effectsText: Expend Mending Charges to remove status effects from a target. 1 Charge: removes Staggered. 2 Charges: removes Poison, Confused, or Rooted. 3 Charges: removes Disease, Hindered, or Stunned.

upgrades.name: Healing Light
upgrades.description: Restore 1d4 HP per Charge used.

upgrades.name: Fortuitous Cleansing
upgrades.description: After purifying, roll 1d10; on 8+ refund the Charge cost.

tier2.name: Compulsion
tier2.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack targeting MR. Success: Target loses will to strike (suffers +MIND penalty to damage for 1 round); if they have a Movement action, they automatically move toward you. Contest MIGHT vs. MIND if Elite. Failure: Target still suffers the damage penalty for 1 round.

upgrades.name: Efficient Cast
upgrades.description: Cost reduced to 3 Faith.

upgrades.name: Directed Movement
upgrades.description: No forced movement; you direct their movement if their action is available.

tier2.name: Champion State
tier2.effectsText: Gain HL to AR, DR, MR, and damage until end of battle or 10 minutes.

upgrades.name: Sacred Purpose
upgrades.description: Also restore half your maximum HP on activation.

tier2.name: Wave of Renewal
tier2.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack to determine X: 2–10 = 1d4, 11–15 = 2d4, 16–20 = 2d6, 21+ = 2d8. Restore X+HL+MIND HP to yourself and all Allies on the battlefield. Lingering: all Nearby characters also restore +MIND HP at the start of their next turn.

upgrades.name: Extended Renewal
upgrades.description: The lingering restoration lasts an additional 2 rounds for a total of 3.

upgrades.name: Damaging Wave
upgrades.description: The initial cast also damages Adjacent and Nearby enemies for 1d8+MIND.

upgrades.name: Inspiring Renewal
upgrades.description: You and all Nearby Allies generate 2 Class Resource (3 if you rolled 20+).

tier2.name: Blessed Practice
tier2.effectsText: Your Divine Shot and Blessed Strike class features now generate 2 Mending Charges on success instead of 1.

tier2.name: Repelling Strike
tier2.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack. Success: Deal Basic Attack damage and push the target Nearby away (enemies do not suffer Provoked Attacks from the displacement). Contest MIGHT vs. MIND if Elite or larger. Failure: Deal half damage.

upgrades.name: Opening Created
upgrades.description: Allies may make Provoked Attacks on the displaced target.

tier2.name: Armed Faith
tier2.effectsText: Without a shield: your AR is increased by +2. With a shield: your AV is increased by +2.

lv3.name: Oracle's Counsel
lv3.effectsText: Ask a single question. Objective questions are answered truthfully to varying degrees. Subjective questions or questions pertaining to creatures with free will are murky and will have haphazard results. Higher powers are mighty, but they do not have domain over free will — if a creature wishes to mask its intent or actions, they are not privy to observe them in that moment.

lv8.name: Revive
lv8.effectsText: Bring a corpse that has been dead no longer than 5 days back to life. Revive is greatly taxing and can only be invoked once a week. On top of costing 6 Faith, you must sacrifice 2,000 gold (or an item of equal or greater value) for each day the corpse has been dead.

lv10.name: Boundless Grace
lv10.effectsText: On activation and each round afterwards you generate 1 Mending Charge for free. Lasts until the end of battle. Outside of combat, using Boundless Grace will automatically restore your entire party to full HP.

baseline.name: Stalwart Form
baseline.effectsText: Increase your MIGHT by +HL. Increase your Max HP and current HP by +MIND. The Max HP increase is lost when you leave this Form. Gives you access to the Iron Stance power (costs 2 Ferocity to use).

baseline.name: Swift Form
baseline.effectsText: Increase your AGILITY by +HL. Increase your damage die for your Basic Attack to 1d12. Gives you access to the Evasive Roll power (spend Ferocity in place of Guile to achieve Evasive Roll's effects).

tier1.name: Charging Form
tier1.effectsText: Each range band you cover before making a melee attack increases that attack's damage by +MIND.

upgrades.name: Wild Charge
upgrades.description: Enemies making Provoked Attacks against you while charging suffer +MIND damage.

upgrades.name: Armored Rush
upgrades.description: Your AV is increased by +MIND against Provoked Attacks while charging.

tier1.name: Elusive Form
tier1.effectsText: Your DR is increased by +MIND and you gain Benefit on Defense rolls against melee attacks.

upgrades.name: Reactive Strike
upgrades.description: When an enemy misses you with a melee attack, immediately retaliate with a Basic Attack.

tier1.name: Hardened Skin
tier1.effectsText: Activate after a failed Defense roll, before the damage roll. Increase your AV by HL+MIND against that single attack.

tier1.name: Frost Spike
tier1.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack. Success: Deal 1d8+HL+MIND Frost damage; generate 3 Ferocity. Failure: Deal half damage; generate 2 Ferocity.

upgrades.name: Ice Split
upgrades.description: Spend 1 additional Spirit to split the spike at an Adjacent target; generates 1 additional Ferocity.

tier1.name: Wild Strikes
tier1.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack. Success: Deal Basic Attack damage, then make a second attack (half damage). Generate 1 Ferocity per hit. If the first attack kills the target, gain additional Ferocity. Failure: Generate 1 Ferocity.

upgrades.name: Persistent Strikes
upgrades.description: Attempt the second strike even if the first attack missed.

upgrades.name: Furious First Strike
upgrades.description: Generate 2 Ferocity from the first attack even on failure.

tier1.name: Grasping Vines
tier1.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack. Success: Deal 1d8+HL+MIND damage; generate 1d4 Ferocity. Failure: Generate 1d4 Ferocity.

upgrades.name: Binding Lash
upgrades.description: A base roll of 15–20 also causes the target to be Staggered for 1 round.

upgrades.name: Wild Growth
upgrades.description: Roll the 1d4 for Ferocity twice and take the highest result.

tier1.name: Nature's Mending
tier1.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack to determine X: 2–11 = 2, 12–18 = 3, 19–22 = 4, 23+ = 6. Restore 1d4+HL+MIND+X HP to the target; generate 2 Ferocity.

upgrades.name: Protective Surge
upgrades.description: The target also gains 1d4 AV against a single incoming attack for 1 round.

upgrades.name: Cascading Mend
upgrades.description: Splash half the restoration to 2 Adjacent Allies.

upgrades.name: Efficient Mending
upgrades.description: Cost reduced to 2 Spirit.

tier1.name: Feral Rush
tier1.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack with Benefit. Success: Deal Basic Attack damage; maximize your Ferocity. Failure: Deal half damage; maximize your Ferocity.

upgrades.name: Shredding Claws
upgrades.description: Double the damage dice.

upgrades.name: Pinning Leap
upgrades.description: Range increased to Far; target is Rooted on success.

tier1.name: Elemental Shard
tier1.effectsText: Choose an element (Arcane, Corrosive, Divine, Electric, Fire, or Frost). Roll your Basic Attack. Success: Deal 1d8+HL+MIND elemental damage; generate 3 Ferocity; target is weakened to that element (next matching element attack gains +1d6 bonus). Failure: Deal half damage; generate 3 Ferocity.

upgrades.name: Elemental Weakness
upgrades.description: The weakness bonus increases to +1d10.

upgrades.name: High Impact
upgrades.description: Damage increased to 2d8+HL+MIND.

tier2.name: Pack Form
tier2.effectsText: You and all Adjacent Allies gain +2 AR and DR.

upgrades.name: Pack Tactics
upgrades.description: On initial activation, you or an Adjacent Ally may move away from Adjacent enemies without triggering Provoked Attacks, provided another Ally is Adjacent to that enemy.

tier2.name: Venom Form
tier2.effectsText: Your melee attacks deal Corrosive damage instead of Physical.

upgrades.name: Corrosive Strike
upgrades.description: On initial activation, generate 1 Spirit per successful enemy strike until the end of your next turn.

tier2.name: Storm Call
tier2.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack to determine X: 2–12 = 3 targets, 13–19 = 4 targets, 20–23 = all enemies, 24+ = all enemies (repeats at start of your next turn). Automatically deal 1d8+MIND Electric damage to X enemies. Generate 3 Ferocity.

upgrades.name: Storm's Edge
upgrades.description: Gain Benefit on the determining roll.

upgrades.name: Healing Rain
upgrades.description: Additionally restore HP to the same number of Allies for 2d6+MIND (also repeats on 24+).

tier2.name: Wind Guard
tier2.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack to determine X: 2–18 = 1 round, 19–22 = 2 rounds, 23+ = 3 rounds. Target gains Benefit on Defense rolls against ranged attacks for X rounds. Generate 2 Ferocity.

upgrades.name: Thorny Wind
upgrades.description: Melee attackers targeting the protected character take 1d4+MIND damage.

upgrades.name: Deflecting Gust
upgrades.description: Missed ranged attacks against the target bounce back to the attacker for half damage.

tier2.name: Biting Swarm
tier2.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack targeting MR. Success: Deal +MIND damage; disable the target from using spells or powers for 1 round; generate 3 Ferocity. Contest MIGHT vs. MIND if larger than Medium or Elite. Failure: Target Staggered; generate 2 Ferocity.

upgrades.name: Toxic Stings
upgrades.description: Damage increased to 2d6+MIND.

upgrades.name: Disorienting Swarm
upgrades.description: The target's AR is also lowered by HL on success.

tier2.name: Wild Energy
tier2.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack to determine X: 2–12 = 1 Ally, 13–19 = 2 Allies, 20–23 = 3 Allies, 24+ = 4 Allies. You and X Allies recharge their Class Resource. Generate X Ferocity.

upgrades.name: Surging Momentum
upgrades.description: Affected characters gain +2 to their next Recharge roll and Benefit on their next action for 1 round.

tier2.name: Natural Affinity
tier2.effectsText: Choose one Form power; permanently reduce its Ferocity activation cost by 1. Can be taken multiple times, once per Form.

tier2.name: Molten Hail
tier2.effectsText: Molten rock erupts somewhere on the battlefield. Roll 1d4 to determine how many gobs are launched. Roll your Basic Attack once. Success: Each gob deals +MIND Fire damage to a random target. Failure: No damage. Maintain to repeat at the start of your next turn.

upgrades.name: Fuel the Fury
upgrades.description: Generate 1 Ferocity per 2 successful hits.

upgrades.name: Increased Volley
upgrades.description: The number of potential targets increases to 1d4+1.

lv3.name: Wild Walk
lv3.effectsText: You can inhabit the body of a willing animal and control it, seeing everything it sees. Lasts 10 minutes. Any damage to the host animal cancels the effect. Your own body is left prone and vulnerable while Wild Walking. Docile and calm animals have a baseline TN of 10. The GM may adjust the TN based on other factors (e.g. the animal is wounded, scared, or aggressive).

lv8.name: Weather Shaping
lv8.effectsText: Cause the weather to change within a radius of up to 50 metres. Choose from: rainfall, strong winds, or a hot sun and clear skies. Outside of combat, Weather Shaping lasts up to half an hour. During combat, the weather can only be maintained for 1 round.

lv10.name: Primal Form
lv10.effectsText: You are instantly restored for half of your Max HP. All Spirit and Ferocity costs are removed for 3 rounds. When Primal Form ends, Spirit and Ferocity are maxed.

baseline.name: Bulwark
baseline.effectsText: When wielding your shield, add the shield's AV to your DR.

baseline.name: Watchful Eye
baseline.effectsText: Select a single enemy anywhere on the battlefield to become your point of focus. Any time that enemy attacks a target that is not you, you may instead make a Basic Attack against that enemy as a Free action at the time they made the attack. Watchful Eye lasts until the end of battle or if you use it again to change to a different target.

tier1.name: Guarded Strike
tier1.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack. Success: Deal Basic Attack damage; gain +MIGHT AV against the next single incoming attack. Failure: Miss but still gain the +MIGHT AV bonus (does not stack).

upgrades.name: Spell Shield
upgrades.description: The AV bonus applies against all damage types except True.

tier1.name: Formation Fighting
tier1.effectsText: Gain +1 damage per Adjacent Ally (maximum HL). At Level 6, Adjacent Allies also gain this bonus.

tier1.name: Shield Expertise
tier1.effectsText: Your shield's AV is increased by +1 (increases to +2 at Level 5, +3 at Level 10).

tier1.name: Shield Bash
tier1.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack. Success: Deal Basic Attack damage + your shield's AV bonus as additional damage. Failure: Deal half Basic Attack damage.

upgrades.name: Stunning Impact
upgrades.description: Target is Staggered on success.

upgrades.name: Efficient Guard
upgrades.description: Cost reduced to 1 Discipline.

tier1.name: Shield Throw
tier1.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack. Success: Deal Basic Attack damage. Failure: Deal half. Shield Return: Roll 2d10; on 11+ the shield returns, on 10 or below retrieve it from the target. Allies can throw it back as a Quick action.

upgrades.name: Returning Arc
upgrades.description: Shield returns on 6+; range increased to Far.

upgrades.name: Powered Throw
upgrades.description: Add your shield's AV as bonus damage; a Massive Hit instantly kills non-Elite targets.

tier1.name: Side by Side
tier1.effectsText: Choose an Adjacent Ally. While both of you remain Adjacent, both of you roll for all offensive and defensive actions of either; take the highest result. Lasts 2 rounds or until separated.

upgrades.name: Coordinated Strike
upgrades.description: Also roll damage dice twice and take the highest.

upgrades.name: Unbreakable Bond
upgrades.description: Effect lasts the entire battle as long as you remain Adjacent.

tier1.name: Missile Deflection
tier1.effectsText: When you are the target of a ranged attack, gain Benefit on your Defense roll.

upgrades.name: Projectile Redirect
upgrades.description: Redirect an Ally's incoming projectile; can extend its range by 1 band or redirect to impossible angles. Costs 1 additional Discipline.

tier1.name: Protective Barrier
tier1.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack to determine X: 2–17 = X+3, 18–22 = X+5, 23–26 = X+7, 27+ = X+10. You and all Adjacent Allies gain that AV bonus. Allies who move away lose the bonus. Lasts up to 2 rounds (you must spend Standard and Movement actions; you cannot move).

upgrades.name: Full Coverage
upgrades.description: The AV bonus applies against all damage types.

upgrades.name: Natural Defender
upgrades.description: Protective Barrier costs no Discipline to activate.

tier1.name: Tactical Launch
tier1.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack to determine X: 2–11 = +2, 12–19 = +3, 20–23 = +4, 24+ = +6. An Adjacent Ally springs to a Nearby location and adds X to their AR and damage on their next attack.

upgrades.name: Extended Launch
upgrades.description: Launch the Ally to Far distance instead of Nearby.

tier2.name: Taunt
tier2.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack targeting MR. Success: Force the target to attack only you for 1 round. Failure: Target Staggered.

upgrades.name: Tunnel Vision
upgrades.description: Gain Benefit on Defense against one of the taunted target's attacks.

upgrades.name: Enraging Challenge
upgrades.description: If you completely evade one of their attacks, gain 4 Discipline.

tier2.name: Vigilant Protector
tier2.effectsText: Your Watchful Eye class feature extends to all enemies within Nearby distance for 2 rounds. You may make a Free Basic Attack against any Adjacent enemy who strikes an Ally.

upgrades.name: Rapid Response
upgrades.description: Spend 1 Discipline to sprint Nearby to an aggressor; this is not a Movement action but you are still susceptible to Provoked Attacks.

upgrades.name: Enduring Protection
upgrades.description: Vigilant Protector lasts an additional round and costs no Discipline.

tier2.name: Thorned Stance
tier2.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack. Success: Deal 1d4+MIGHT damage to 1d4 Adjacent enemies. Failure: Deal half. While Maintained, any enemy who melee attacks you suffers your AV value as Physical damage.

upgrades.name: Efficient Thorns
upgrades.description: Cost reduced to 2 Discipline for both activation and maintenance.

upgrades.name: Reinforced Thorns
upgrades.description: Initial strikes hit 1d4+1 enemies; retaliation damage increases by +1d4.

tier2.name: Take the Hit
tier2.effectsText: When an Adjacent Ally is targeted by an attack, jump between them and the attacker and make the Defense roll in their stead.

upgrades.name: Rush to Aid
upgrades.description: Spend 1 additional Discipline to extend the range to Nearby.

upgrades.name: Braced Intercept
upgrades.description: Add HL to your DR against the intercepted attack.

tier2.name: Iron Will
tier2.effectsText: Gain (LEVEL−2)+MIGHT temporary HP; your maximum HP increases by this amount. Lasts for the battle or 10 minutes. After the effect ends, the temporary HP is lost.

upgrades.name: Fortified Will
upgrades.description: Your AR is also increased by half your AV while Iron Will is active.

upgrades.name: Rallying Defense
upgrades.description: Adjacent Allies generate 2 Class Resource on activation.

tier2.name: Hold the Line
tier2.effectsText: When you have an opportunity for a Provoked Attack against a moving target, roll your Basic Attack. Success: Deal damage and cancel the target's movement. Contest MIGHT vs. MIGHT if Elite or larger. Failure: Deal half damage.

upgrades.name: Immovable Guardian
upgrades.description: Gain Benefit on the attack roll.

upgrades.name: Practiced Defense
upgrades.description: Cost reduced to 1 Discipline.

tier2.name: Defensive Footwork
tier2.effectsText: Gain HL as a DR bonus against Provoked Attacks.

tier2.name: Repelling Push
tier2.effectsText: Roll your Basic Attack. Success: Deal Basic Attack damage + your shield's AV bonus; displace both yourself and the target Nearby away in opposite directions (neither suffers Provoked Attacks). Contest MIGHT vs. MIGHT if Elite. Failure: Deal half damage; refund 1 Discipline and your unused Movement action.

upgrades.name: Opening Move
upgrades.description: Allies may make Provoked Attacks against the displaced target.

upgrades.name: Chase Down
upgrades.description: Displace the target Nearby away while you remain; then charge at them.

lv3.name: Iron Endurance
lv3.effectsText: You receive an additional HL as bonus Recuperations per day. You now have the ability to also give away your Recuperations to your Allies.

lv8.name: Unshakeable
lv8.effectsText: In combat, any attack that attempts to displace you is resisted completely. Outside of combat, events or actions that would send a lesser warrior sprawling are stopped cold when inflicted upon you.

lv10.name: Wounded Resolve
lv10.effectsText: For every 20 HP you are missing, you receive +1 to your DR.
